title: 第二条件句：假设、建议与可能性

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Complete the present hypothetical: If I ____ more time, I would visit again.
questions.evidence: If I had more time, I would visit again.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句的 if 从句用一般过去式 had 表假设；have 是现实条件形式，will have 和 having 不符合该结构。

questions.prompt: Complete the hypothetical result: If Mara lived nearby, she ____ ask the staff.
questions.evidence: If Mara lived nearby, she would ask the staff.
questions.explanation: 主句用 would 加原形 ask；will to、would to 结构错误，would 不加 s。

questions.prompt: Choose the clause describing a hypothetical present situation.
options: If Dev would to travel less
questions.evidence: If Dev traveled less, he would consider a visit.
questions.explanation: 假设从句使用一般过去式 traveled；其他选项误用 will、缺有限谓语或使用 would to。

questions.prompt: Complete the hypothetical: If we ____ a larger room, we would invite more people.
questions.evidence: If we had a larger room, we would invite more people.
questions.explanation: if 从句用过去式 had 表示现在的假设；其余三项不能构成标准第二条件句。

questions.prompt: Choose the standard hypothetical advice: If I ____ you, I would ask first.
questions.evidence: If I were you, I would ask first.
questions.explanation: 标准假设建议常用 If I were you；am 是现实现在时，be 未变形，will be 不用于此假设从句。

questions.prompt: Complete the formal hypothetical: If she ____ free, she would visit.
questions.evidence: If she were free, she would visit.
questions.explanation: 较正式的虚拟条件可用 she were；is、being、will be 不符合这里要求的标准假设形式。

questions.prompt: Complete the formal hypothetical: If he ____ here, he would help.
questions.evidence: If he were here, he would help.
questions.explanation: 假设他现在不在这里时可用 he were；is 是现实现在时，be 未变形，will be 不符合该从句。

questions.prompt: Complete the hypothetical: If we ____ ready, we would call.
questions.evidence: If we were ready, we would call.
questions.explanation: we 的过去式假设用 were；are 是现实现在时，am 主谓不一致，will be 不符合该结构。

questions.prompt: Complete the possible hypothetical result: If I had a bicycle, I could ____ to the park.
questions.evidence: 假设结果中 could 加动词原形表示一种可能或能力；would 加动词原形常表达预期结果。could 后不接 to，也不同时加 can。
questions.explanation: could 后接原形 ride；不能再加 to，也不用三单 rides 或 ing。

questions.prompt: Complete the possible hypothetical result: If we had a map, we could ____ the museum.
questions.evidence: 假设结果中 could 加动词原形表示一种可能或能力；would 加动词原形常表达预期结果。could 后不接 to，也不同时加 can。
questions.explanation: could 后接原形 find；其余三个选项分别多了 to、三单词尾或 ing。

questions.prompt: Complete the possible hypothetical result: If Lina had a camera, she could ____ a photo.
questions.evidence: 假设结果中 could 加动词原形表示一种可能或能力；would 加动词原形常表达预期结果。could 后不接 to，也不同时加 can。
questions.explanation: could 后用动词原形 take；to take、takes、taking 都不符合情态动词结构。

questions.prompt: Complete the possible hypothetical result: If the room were quiet, we could ____ the speaker.
questions.evidence: 假设结果中 could 加动词原形表示一种可能或能力；would 加动词原形常表达预期结果。could 后不接 to，也不同时加 can。
questions.explanation: could 后接原形 hear；不能加 to，也不用 hears 或 hearing。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations; the last four questions transfer the rule to new situations.
passage:
1. 第二条件句常用 if 加一般过去时，主句用 would 加动词原形，谈论现在或将来的假设，并不表示该条件已经真实发生。与真实可能的第一条件句区分。
例句：If I had more time, I would visit again. If Mara lived nearby, she would ask the staff. If Dev traveled less, he would consider a visit. If we had a larger room, we would invite more people.

2. 虚拟建议中常用 If I were you，表示“如果我是你”；were 在较正式的假设表达中也可用于 I、he 和 she。非正式口语可能听到 was，但本练习采用 were。
例句：If I were you, I would ask first. If she were free, she would visit. If he were here, he would help. If we were ready, we would call.

3. 假设结果中 could 加动词原形表示一种可能或能力；would 加动词原形常表达预期结果。could 后不接 to，也不同时加 can。
例句：If I had a free day, I could visit. If she had time, she would help.
